intro.text: An Unkalaki related to Kef'ha and Lunamor.

items.text: Tifi was part of the family group that came to the Shattered Plains with Kef'ha, who hoped to win Shardplate from Sadeas. Sadeas killed Kef'ha without a proper duel, and Tifi and Sinaku'a were among those killed when they raised weapons in revenge.
Reunited with Lunamor, Tuaka asked after Sinaku'a and Tifi, but Lunamor did not want to talk about it.
